summary: Frontend E2E on web preview. Found a CRITICAL Metro bundling failure on first load: 'Unable to resolve module react-native-svg from lucide-react-native/dist/esm/Icon.mjs'. The whole app rendered a red Server Error screen — every flow blocked. Root cause: lucide-react-native@1.14 has react-native-svg as a peer dependency, but it was NOT in package.json/node_modules. Fixed by `yarn add react-native-svg@15.12.1` (Expo-recommended version) and restarting expo. After fix, the landing screen renders correctly (screenshot verified): flame badge, IGNITE NUTRITION brand, particle background, 'Ignite Your Journey' primary CTA, and 'Try the AI nutrition coach (no login)' ghost button all visible. While re-running the full E2E I discovered the second blocker: the testIDs in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx do NOT match the names listed in the review_request, so the scripted CSS/data-testid selectors all miss. Did not have run-budget to retest every screen with corrected selectors; landing visual verification is complete, the rest of the flow needs a re-run after E1 aligns testIDs.

Several other Expo SDK mismatches reported but non-fatal: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0), expo-blur 55.0.14 (~15.0.8), expo-image-picker 55.0.20 (~17.0.11), expo-linear-gradient 55.0.13 (~15.0.8). Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' appearing 6+ times. Cosmetic, but worth migrating before SDK bump.

rca_of_issue: RCA: Missing peer dependency. lucide-react-native@1.14.0 imports `react-native-svg` from its Icon.mjs ESM entry but does not list it in its own dependencies (it is a peerDependency that the host app must install). Project's package.json never added react-native-svg, so Metro's resolver failed at bundle time, producing a Server Error red screen at every route. Repro: fresh `yarn install`, start expo, open https://ignite-nutrition.preview.emergentagent.com — see 'Unable to resolve module react-native-svg from /app/frontend/node_modules/lucide-react-native/dist/esm/Icon.mjs'. Mitigation applied: `yarn add react-native-svg@15.12.1` (the version Expo SDK 55 expects), then `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`. Verified post-fix: landing screen renders fully with no red screen.
